items.title: AMD CEO Su on earnings outlook, new Starbucks holiday menu, and Hilton CEO on hotel demand
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi tackles the biggest news of the market day, including AMD's (AMD) earnings outlook topping estimates as chip demand soars, what the blue wave in Congress means for a market rally, and how Starbucks (SBUX) plans its business around the holiday season with new products. 

Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Hilton (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta to discuss AI's impact on the hospitality industry.

items.title: Qualcomm, Micron, Sandisk, and AMD stocks sink, leading chip sector lower
items.summary: Qualcomm, Micron, and Arm Holdings were all trading lower on Thursday as chip stocks continued to slide.

items.title: AMD is a 'data center first' company, says CEO Lisa Su
items.summary: AMD (AMD) CEO Lisa Su sits down with Yahoo Finance's Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss rapid AI adoption driving massive data center demand, address Wall Street's short-term skepticism over hyperscaler spending, and explain why sustained investments in computing power are essential for long-term growth.

items.title: AMD Tumbles 13%, NVIDIA Slides 7% as AI Regulation Fears Hit Chip Stocks; Intel Sinks 8%
items.summary: Political risk is outweighing strong earnings across the AI chip trade, and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) is taking the hardest hit. AMD stock is at $424.36, down 13% in morning trading. The slide comes days after the chipmaker reported a quarter that CEO Lisa Su said “was the largest and most profitable in our history.” […]

items.title: AMD Sinks 13%, Bloom Energy Down 18% as Midterm “Seismic Shift” Deepens Chip Sell-Off
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD fell 13% today, with Intel and Bloom Energy also lower, on fears that Democrats’ midterm sweep will slow the AI data-center build-out. AMD had no news of its own, two days after a strong quarter and a forecast for 80%-plus revenue growth in 2027.

items.title: Here Are the Stocks Getting Hit Hardest in Today’s Rotation
items.summary: As investors reassess their portfolios after Tuesday's blue wave, they're positioning for a slowdown in the AI build-out, knocking chip and data-center stocks.

items.title: Qualcomm stock drops on rising memory pricing, supply challenges
items.summary:
Both shares of Qualcomm (QCOM) and Arm Holdings (ARM) are sinking in Thursday's pre-market trading since each company reported its respective earnings results yesterday.

Interactive Brokers Chief Strategist Steve Sosnick joins Pras Subramanian and Brooke DiPalma on The 8:30 to discuss memory chip pricing and supply challenges that Qualcomm is facing.
